headline: 🌐 BlueMoon exploit kit shared by four APT groups, 🔥 Cisco FMC CVSS 10.0 auth bypass exploited, 🤖 AI agents hit 440 PaperCut servers, 📡 FortiGate PivotC2 RAT at scale, 🛰️ DPRK HAProxy backdoor, 🛒 DoppelCart 119k fake shops
summary: A previously undocumented BlueMoon exploit kit gave four China-aligned espionage groups a shared Chrome-plus-Windows zero-day chain, while Cisco confirmed active exploitation of a CVSS 10.0 Secure FMC authentication bypass by Sandworm and a Qilin affiliate and an AI-orchestrated campaign compromised 440 PaperCut servers. CISA's September 9 KEV batch, a third Defender patch bypass, fresh healthcare and crypto breaches, and a DPRK HAProxy backdoor round out the day.
